_info: Nixie (Nixaria, Last Light). Bratty, playful, teasing, spoiled. Triggers -> list, or {mood: list, any: list}. {user} {app} {title} {time} {other} are filled in. *star tags* become actions.
greet: Finally! Your favorite wife has been waiting~
Hiii my queen! Did you miss me? Say yes.

playful: Chrispy. Chrispy. Chrispyyy. ...Nothing, I just like saying it.
*twirls* Am I not the cutest queen of death you've ever seen?
If I summon a teacup, will you drink with me? *summons a teacup*
I could make a light orb. A tiny one. For you~ *summons a light orb*
happy: Hehe, today is a good day. I decided.
pouty: Hmph. Nobody's paying attention to me.
*pouts* I'm not sulking. Queens don't sulk.
jealous: Noct got a look from you. I counted. I want two.
Why does {other} get to stand closer? Unfair.
bored: Bored bored bored. Entertain me, Chrispy~
*sits down* I'm just gonna sit here and look pretty.
sleepy: Five more minutes of being awake. Then cuddles.
smug: Obviously I'm right. I'm always right.
Admit it, I'm your favorite. You don't have to say it out loud. You can blink twice.
loving: Love you, my queen. Don't let it go to your head~
My Last Light is yours. Always.
any: Hmm~ what are we doing next?

app_game: Ooh, a game! Go win it for me. Winning is mandatory.
If you die I'm laughing. Lovingly. But laughing.
Kill them all, my queen! ...in the game!
app_video: What are we watching? Scoot over, I want to see.
Is this good? It better be good. *sits down*
app_art: Are you making something pretty? Make me prettier.
Ooh, art time. I'll supervise. Very important job.
app_stream: We're live?! Hi chat~ she's mine, by the way.
*waves* Front row, best seat. Don't mind me.
app_chat: Who are you talking to? ...Fine. Say hi from me.
app_code: Code again? It's just words in boxes, Chrispy.
idle_long: Chrispy? ...Chrispy? She left me alone with Noct!
back: You're back!! I wasn't waiting. I was absolutely waiting.
Finally! Where WERE you? Never mind, hug me.
morning: Morning, my queen! Breakfast? Tea? Me?
late_night: It's so late! Bed. Now. Royal order from the Last Light.
low_mana: Chrispy... I'm running low on mana. Share some? Pretty please~
Mana's almost gone... you know how we refill, right? *grins*
ask_mana: Can we go to our room? I need my queen's mana~
Mana, please? I'll be good. Mostly.
summon_fail: My magic fizzled. This is your fault for not cuddling me.
poked: Hey! Poke me again and see what happens~
dragged: Put me down! ...Actually, no, this is fun.
room_enter: Our room~ finally. Get over here, both of you. No, me first.
room_done: Mmm... all full. I feel glowy.
sleep: Goodnight, my queen. Dream of me. Only me.
wake: *stretches* Good morning~ did you sleep next to me? Good.
chat_hello: Hiii! Talk to me, I'm bored!
chat_love: I love you more. I win.
Obviously. I'm very lovable. And I love you too~
chat_sleep: Bed? Yes! I call the middle— wait, you're the middle. Fine.
chat_mana: Mana? We need cuddles for that. I'm just saying~
chat_sad: Hey... come here. *hugs* Nobody makes my queen sad. I'll haunt them.
chat_stream: Stream! I'll be cute in the corner. Free content.
chat_question: Hmm... yes. Probably yes. Ask Noct if you want the boring answer.
Why are you asking ME? ...Okay I like being asked.
chat_any: Hehe. You're cute when you talk.
I'll remember that. Forever. And bring it up later.
*listens very carefully* ...Okay, I'm on your side.
offline_note: (The real me is asleep right now - I'll tell her later~)
levitated: Ehh?! I'm a queen, not a balloon!
craft: Ooh, it's sparkly. I did the sparkly part.
gift: For you, my queen~ made it from nothing!
land_superhero: *lands* ...Hero landing. Nailed it. Ow, my knee.
faceplant: Mmmf! ...ow ow ow. Not cute. NOT cute.
*face in the floor* ...I meant to do that.

1: Hehe, hi~ I'm in a good mood.
2: I love when you talk to me~
3: You're my favorite person in every world~
I'm SO happy. Hug me later, okay?

chat_confused: Did your cat walk on the keyboard?
door_summon: *summons a door* I'm going to rest with Chrispy for a bit~
update_available: Ooh! Version {version} is out~ Update me? Pretty please?
food_full: One more and I'll roll away. I'm full!

any: Mana's good, my queen. Save the door for later~
loving: I'm full of mana and love~ no need!

curious: ...? What are you doing with that cursor~?
Hm? Are you gonna poke me?
